page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m4.large is a burstable virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, and is paired with 8.0 GB of system memory. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the lower performance tiers. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests scored 1161.28 and 2371.48 respectively, categorizing them in the bottom 25%. Memory performance is similarly constrained, with large-block read bandwidth at 22.38 GB/sec (bottom 10%) and write bandwidth at 19.14 GB/sec (bottom 25%). Geekbench testing yielded a single-core score of 1092.0 and a multi-core score of 1822.0, reflecting its burstable CPU allocation model.

Given its burstable CPU allocation and lower-tier benchmark performance, this instance offers a highly cost-efficient profile for workloads that do not require sustained high CPU utilization. It is suitable for low-traffic web serving, development environments, lightweight background tasks, and basic testing. It is not recommended for memory-intensive databases, large language model inference, or sustained high-throughput computing due to its baseline network limits and burstable CPU constraints.
